name: Postiz
summary: Open-source social media scheduling platform to plan, cross-post and analyze content, self-hosted or as Postiz Cloud.
description: A social media management platform: schedule and cross-post posts, keep calendar views, collaborate with teammates on posts and comments, and measure results with analytics. AI features cover a copilot, images, videos, video clipping and a Smart Agent, while a public API, webhooks, Node.js SDK, n8n node, Make.com integration and MCP/CLI connectors hook it into automation. Deploy the open-source edition on your own infrastructure (Docker; Postgres, storage) or use the managed Postiz Cloud. Monorepo built with Next.js, NestJS, Prisma, Temporal and Resend.
contains: schedules and cross-posts social content; repeated posts, delays, sets, signatures, RSS auto-post
analytics, calendar views, team collaboration, comments and customer groups
AI features: copilot, images, videos, video clipping and Smart Agent
public API, webhooks, Node.js SDK, n8n custom node and Make.com integration
agentic surfaces: MCP, CLI and Claude / ChatGPT / Codex / Cursor connectors
open-source edition self-hosts with Docker; you create your own platform developer apps
Postiz Cloud: subscription plans, 7-day free trial, pre-approved apps, managed updates
monorepo: pnpm workspaces, Next.js (React), NestJS, Prisma, Temporal, Resend
